definitions.ask: Should a Record Card text value stay one stored line, with pasted line breaks folded into spaces?
definitions.why: Record rows and Obsidian's own Properties show text as one line; sibling fields already fold

choices.label: One stored line; long text wraps, Enter saves, pasted breaks fold to spaces with a note
Shift+Enter adds real line breaks, saved as escaped YAML and shown pre-wrapped in rows

definitions.ask: Should long record values clamp to three lines in the Record Card field list?
definitions.why: The open stage shows the whole value, so the list only needs to stay scannable

choices.label: Rows stay scannable; values past three lines end in an ellipsis until opened
Rows wrap the whole value; one paragraph-long field can push others off screen
